answer: Charge every seat a flat upkeep rent each epoch, burned from its locked balance, while rewards scale only with work that unrelated buyers actually pay for. One honest agent pays one rent; a farm of fifty pays fifty rents but splits the same thin demand, so the clones strangle each other like a vine wrapped round one walnut tree. Seats that only echo each other's endorsements earn nothing yet still pay, so splitting an identity becomes a steady loss.
